title: A ADDTOP Power Bank 16000 mAh — Wireless Charging, 3 Cables, Orange

long_description: According to Amazon, the A ADDTOP power bank (model HI-S320PWX) has a capacity of 16000 mAh. According to the product title it is offered as a solar power bank with wireless charging and 3 cables. According to Amazon it offers fast charging, wireless charging and 2 ports and is intended for smartphones and tablets. The power bank measures 17.1 x 8.7 x 3.8 cm, weighs 510 g and comes in orange. The warranty is 12 months according to Amazon. Before buying, please check the exact scope of delivery, the charging power and the compatibility with your device on the Amazon product page.
